name: TopoGS
definition: A topology-aware anchor feature aggregation framework for large-scale 3D Gaussian Splatting that addresses the feature isolation problem in octree-based representations by establishing cross-level gradient pathways and modulating aggregation through octree containment relations.
summary: TopoGS is a topology-aware feature aggregation framework for 3D Gaussian Splatting that resolves feature isolation by explicitly modeling octree containment relations rather than relying on spatial proximity.
